title: Let's Build an Instant Kill Death Ray
description:
It's April fools day, so time to tap into our inner trickster and make a contraption to be the dread of all players who come upon it. In this video we investigate how we can make the most effective area denial weaponry in minecraft, all from a basic idea that, well, doesn't work out the way we expected.
